verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Smart Meetings feature is documented as finding "the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules" [reclaim-docs-5]. Supporting docs show it keeps re-optimizing: Smart Meetings carry priority levels, are auto-rescheduled when conflicts arise, and only lock at 4am on the day of the meeting, which implies they move until then [reclaim-docs-33, reclaim-docs-34, reclaim-docs-41, reclaim-docs-29]. missing for 10: detailed docs on how "best" is determined beyond the first open slot (e.g., weighing attendee preferences or focus time), explicit description of continuous re-optimization specific to multi-attendee meetings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Smart Meetings.
